title: hey pumpkin <3

events.title: the first date
events.subtitle: baltimore
events.body:
somehow we both managed to find each other on a stupid little app and that managed to be the best decision of my life

and somehow you actually agreed to go on a date with me

we watched the fireworks from on top of that hill and neither of us knew what the next year was about to turn into

events.title: the kiss incident
events.subtitle: second date
events.body:
before our first kiss i did what any normal romantic person would do

i asked chatgpt

best ways to ask for a kiss

and somehow that worked 😭

events.title: la tavola
events.subtitle: the night i knew
events.body:
we went to la tavola and then sat on those benches at federal hill and talked our ears off all night

somewhere during all of that i realized this wasnt just some girl i liked anymore

i knew my feelings for you were real

events.title: water lantern festival
events.subtitle: when i wanted to realy take it serious
events.body:
one of my favorite dates ever

this was the night i finally explained how i felt and told you i wanted us to be exclusive and that you were the one for me

somehow everything felt just as good as it looked

events.title: your birthday picnic
events.subtitle: birthday weekend
events.body:
we celebrated your day with one of the best picnics oat

still one of your favorite dates and one of mine too

events.title: victory royale
events.subtitle: penn state
events.body:
you came all the way up to penn state to spend the weekend with me

and after months of trying to act normal about how much i liked you i finally asked you to be my girlfriend

with possibly the corniest fortnite victory royale poster ever created

somehow she said yes and this day changed my entire life for the better

events.title: fall festival
events.subtitle: pumpkins with pumpkin
events.body:
we dressed up went to the fall festival and painted pumpkins

just another excuse to go somewhere together and somehow make it one of my favorite days

events.title: field of screams
events.subtitle: field of screams
events.body: we dressed up as batman and catwoman (btw you looked real sexy) and somehow made getting scared together look cute

events.title: our first trip
events.subtitle: new york city
events.body:
our first trip together

central park zoo because visiting zoos everywhere we go is our thing

then you surprised me with the one piece exhibit

that whole day was perfect and one of the best gifts ive ever received :)

events.title: thanksgiving
events.subtitle: our first ever thanksgiving but not our last
events.body:
getting to spend thanksgiving together with both our families felt so beautiful in the best way

like you had already become part of my life

events.title: christas dates
events.subtitle: kick ass date
events.body:
we made cookies and built a gingerbread house

and yes it was kick ass

events.title: i love you
events.subtitle: 12 am
events.body:
it was cold out and i had just dropped you off after an amazing date

you pulled me outside because you had something you wanted to tell me

you were so nervous

then you finally said it

i love you

and i dont think you realized how happy i was that i finally got to say it back

events.title: our first christmas
events.subtitle: christmas together
events.body:
our first christmas together

one of those little milestones that made everything feel even more real

events.title: sanse 26
events.subtitle: puerto rico
events.body:
one of the best fricking times of my life and i got to do it with my wife

yeah i am going to wife you up

events.title: penguins for my birthday
events.subtitle: baltimore zoo
events.body:
we went to see penguins at the baltimore zoo

fuck tetra

events.title: our first valentines
events.subtitle: a very successful bad idea
events.body:
we snuck you into my house without permission

we got caught lol

then went to the wharf ice skated and finally tried qui qui

romantic criminal activity lol

events.title: philly adventure
events.subtitle: zoo + baseball
events.body:
another city another zoo

then we got to see the braves beat the phillies

never thought id like philly until i went with you

events.title: your first mets game
events.subtitle: an adventure for sure
events.body: i got to take you to your first mets game and somehow the whole adventure was even better because i secretely became a mets fan

events.title: rafs wedding
events.subtitle: looking way too good together
events.body: another one of those days where i kept looking at you and wondering how i got this lucky

events.title: amazing dates with my love
events.subtitle: the normal days mattered too
events.body:
not every memory needs its own anniversary date

sometimes it was just food, car rides, facetime, fortnite, random plans, and finding any excuse to see each other

those days became some of my favorites too

events.title: our almost july 4
events.subtitle: before basic camp
events.body:
realizing that we couldnt recreate our first date on july 4 because i had to leave for basic camp was depressing

then god sent me the biggest blessing ever, a fireworks show the weekend before

it was one of the most magical and saddest nights because i knew i was leaving soon

but we still found a way to have our fireworks and express our love for each other once again

events.title: another birthday with you
events.subtitle: one year later and still mine
events.body: getting another birthday with you felt like one of those quiet reminders that we really made it through a whole year together

love_notes: i love how you always notice when im staring at you even when i dont say anything
i love the famous face you make when i say something you absolutely do not believe
i love that you mispronounce random names and i hear it every time but never say anything because its cute
i love how your default picture pose is always the kissy face
i love how you somehow become five years younger when you really smile
i love that you blink a lot and somehow even that became something i notice about you
i love how you sleep diagonally like the whole bed belongs to you
i love that you try to pay for things because you think you dont do enough even though you already do more than enough
i love how skeptical you get when i call you the prettiest girl in the world even though im literally just telling the truth
i love your weird little frog throat scratch noise
i love getting food with you at literally any chance we get
i love your random moments of silence
i love when you get shy after i kiss you in public
i love when you hit on me as a joke
i love hearing you complain about work because somehow i even miss that when youre not around
i love how you always need your puffcorn snack
i love that youre watching one piece because you know how much i love it
i love that playing fortnite with you somehow became one of my favorite normal things
i love seeing the version of you that gets super goofy when nobody else is around
i love that you are still my favorite person to annoy
i love cooking for you
i love doing absolutely nothing with you
i love how much of my life started feeling like ours
i love that even after the rough days we keep choosing each other
i love you for who you are not just for everything we do together

letter:
pumpkin

i dont even know how to fully explain what this year has meant to me because it feels like somehow you became such a huge part of my life without me even realizing how fast it was happening

when i think about us i think about all the big things like 4th of july, the lantern festival, new york, puerto rico, valentines, baseball games, zoos, and every trip we managed to turn into an adventure but i also think about the little things just as much

i think about facetime and me lying that im not tired right before falling asleep
i think about getting food with you every chance we get
i think about your frog noises, your kissy face, your famous look when you dont believe something i said and all the little things about you that i probably notice way more than you think i do

you have given me so many memories and so many blessings this year and i really dont know where id be without you

i know we have days where we cry or fight or get confused and nothing feels perfect but i love that we keep getting through those days together
every one of them teaches us something and reminds me that even when things are hard i still choose you
i still want you next to me
i still want to figure it out with you

i want you to always know that you are loved appreciated safe and wanted with me
you never have to earn that by paying for more or doing more or trying to prove anything to me
you already do enough just by being you and by loving me the way you do

you are the prettiest girl in the world even when you dont believe me
you are my favorite person to bother
my favorite person to feed
my favorite person to travel with
my favorite person to play fortnite with
and somehow still the person i miss even when i just saw you

this first year gave me more than i ever expected from a stupid little app

and when i think about year two i dont really care what the exact plans look like
i want more zoos more trips more, another sanse, more mets games, more braves games, way too much fortnite, and eventually somehow finishing one piece with you

but more than any of that i just want us to keep choosing each other

i love you so much pumpkin
and you will always be my mine 😘
year_two: and through all of it still choosing each other
